summary.name: Designs.ai
summary.one_liner: Designs.ai is an AI creative workspace where specialist agents turn a single brief into on-brand images, video, copy, design, audio, and slides.
use_cases: Build a complete visual identity or logo
Plan storyboards and produce short videos
Assemble ready-to-use campaign assets from one brief
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a single AI workspace with specialist agents: a Brand Agent for complete visual identities, an Image Agent for visuals, a Storyboard Agent that turns scenes into video plans, a Video Agent for end-to-end video production, a Slides Agent for presentation decks, and an Audio Agent for studio-quality audio. It says the workspace routes each task to the right model and aims to keep brand consistency across outputs. It also lists a library of ready-to-use skills across finance, creative, legal and other areas. The page does not give technical details on models, export formats or limits.
notable: Specialist agents (Brand, Image, Storyboard, Video, Slides, Audio) working from one brief
Routes each task to the right AI model
Ready-to-use skills library covering finance, creative, legal and more
caveats: Pricing tiers and limits are not stated on the page; the 'freemium' label comes from the directory listing, not the page text
